Title: Create New Forum Workflow
Description: Steps to create a new forum with specific name, title, description, and sidebar content.
- Navigate to the 'Forums' section from the main page.
- Click the 'Create forum' link to open the creation form.
- Fill the required 'Name' field with the forum name.
- Fill the required 'Title' field with the forum title.
- Fill the required 'Description' field with the desired text.
- Fill the required 'Sidebar' field with a markdown list of items.
- Click the 'Create forum' button to submit the form.

Title: Forum Creation Form Requirements
Description: Key form fields and validation rules observed during the creation process.
- The 'Name' field is required and must be filled to proceed.
- The 'Title' field is required and is separate from the 'Name' field.
- The 'Description' field is required and accepts text input.
- The 'Sidebar' field is required and supports markdown bullet lists.
- All four fields (Name, Title, Description, Sidebar) must be completed before submission.
- The 'Create forum' button becomes actionable once all required fields are populated.
